en: Sepia-toned ethnographic postcard showing a kneeling, bare‑chested person in a striped cloth before two large, heavily adorned ritual figures or statues. The central figure is tall, covered with objects, wearing a mask-like face and feathered headdress; a smaller figure with a sword or staff stands beside it. The lower half of the card is blank except for printed red text. Along the left edge there is a vertical publisher credit, and at the bottom center and right are captions in red.
